clauses.title: Worktree precondition for autofix
requires: local `HEAD` and PR branch ref at public `H`
neither mode mutates operator/shared config, branch refs, or index
All gates, correction, validation, manifest, commit, push, and post-push actions use workspace cwd.

clauses.title: A failed terminal operator recheck stops the run BLOCKED
Repository-root Pi runtime exclusion is narrow and fail-closed
requires: safe no-follow classification of every enumerated `RUNTIME_ROOTS` member
Staged deletion never cures a forbidden parent path
